name: Cracked Pocket Compass
description: A brass pocket compass found on the unveiling platform where Venn had stood.
inspectText: The glass is cracked inward, the needle is pinned at an odd angle, and a tiny flake of blue sealing wax is caught beneath the hinge.

name: Weatherproof Sketchbook
description: Tomas Reed’s oilskin-bound sketchbook, recovered from a paint-stained crate in the newspaper loft.
inspectText: The pages are damp at the corners but intact. Several drawings are dated with precise times in a neat illustrator’s hand.
